public.title: Largest Number
public.description: Arrange all nonnegative integers so their decimal concatenation is greatest, and return it as a string. There are 1 to 500 values, each at most 1000000. If all digits are zero return "0".
hints: Compare a+b with b+a as strings.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Pairwise concatenation order determines the best adjacent order; sorting by that comparator maximizes the entire concatenation. Normalize all-zero input. O(n log n) comparisons.
